status: Working assumptions for normalized cohort model; not a calibrated national forecast.

xr.clinical_exit_share_definition: Eligible improvement share: efficacy-only13/30 reported Berolife stops; AE7/30 excluded. Cross-cohort proxy applied to historicalUS all-cause discontinuation.
xr.working_choice_rationale: User selects half of efficacy-only discontinuations avoided as working assumption:61%+39%*(13/30)*50%=69.45%. Downside61%; noAEbenefit. Premium8.45pp or13.85%relative; notmeasuredPHVSretention.
xr.mature_status: Inherited unmeasured assumption; no repeated first-year benefit.

switching.status: Uncalibrated empirical rates; explicit origin-specific underwriting ranges and prescription-to-paid timing implemented in xr_entry_model.py. Older attempt/access grid remains separate illustrative mechanics.

ir.status: LTP extension benchmark applies only to that selected population. No universal commercial redosing chosen. PHVS17%is not an LTP-matched comparator.
ir.consumption_formula: attacks * fraction treated * PHVS share conditional on treated * (1+repeat-dose fraction)
ir.paid_supply: Inventory, free supply, pack size and net price required before revenue. Do not apply an additional consumption haircut to observed dispensing.

market_calibration.use: Historical aggregate stock-growth and origin-mix checks; no automatic replacement of PHVS switching probabilities.

population_growth.method: Single net annual rate for diagnosed/addressable population; detailed demographics superseded by user request
population_growth.interpretation: Analyst-selected1.5%net growth anchored to treated HAE history;0–3%scenario range, not confidence interval or causal estimate of company case-finding
guardrails: Do not additionally add150–250new diagnoses or subtract separate population mortality.
Rate grows diagnosed/addressable population, not assumed genetic incidence or PHVS market share.
Keep changes in prevention uptake separate from total population growth.
No separate mortality haircut layered on net market growth; patient-level all-cause retention remains a different flow.
